Complimentary Pick up and drop off in Niagara Falls.Only our package includes $30-$40 dollars coupons for restaurant and other attractions and Complimentary bottles of water is included. services.name: Day Tour with illumination lights and Fireworks Option added
services.desc: Join us! Duration Part 1 during the day approx. 4-5 hr Part 2 at night approx. 15 to 20 minutes illumination light About Enjoy our USA side tour including the Maid of the Mist, Cave of the Winds, Niagara Observation Tower, and much more. Our professional tour guide will show you terrific views of Niagara Falls as well as provide you with interesting facts and stories about the Falls and its history. After your tour during the day is complete we take you back to your hotel. At 6:30PM we will pick you up again and take you to Niagara Falls State Park to see the evening Illumination light

services.name: Autumn/Spring Tour with Winery Option
services.desc: Enjoy Niagara Falls in the Winter and Spring season on this all-inclusive tour. You will experience the gorge walk at the Cave of the Winds as well as majestic views of the Falls from many different perspectives. Enjoy a complimentary hot drink and cookie at one of the area's most popular bakeries. Conclude your tour with a visit to historic Lewiston and a tasting at a local winery. Note: The boat is closed for the season and not included on this tour. Duration 4-5 hours Includes: 1.CAVE OF THE WINDS (Gorge Walk) 2.TERRAPIN POINT 3.NIAGARA STATE PARK 4.GOAT ISLAND 5.AMERICAN FALLS 6.LUNA ISLAND (Scenic View) 7.SCENIC VIEW HORSESHOE FALLS USA SIDE 8.HISTORIC LEWISTON 9.WINE TASTING AT LOCAL

services.name: Niagara Falls Canada Evening Tour
services.desc: Make unforgettable memories on this hassle-free once in a lifetime experience as you see the best of that Niagara Falls, Canada has to offer. Your experienced tour guide will lead you around all of the many sites of Canada as you explore the tunnels at the magnificent Journey Behind the Falls, and ride to the top of the soaring Skylon Tower to see the majestic Falls from above. Cap off the evening with the spectacular Illumination Light Show and Fireworks. Duration 5-6 hours Includes: Illumination Light Show Fireworks at Falls (Seasonal) Journey Behind the Falls Clifton Hill Floral Clock Horseshoe Falls Scenic view of American falls Skylon Tower Whirlpool What's included All attractions

services.name: Private Walking Tour with Boat Cave and Trolley
services.desc: Guided tour and shuttle transportation for a group of 75 guests. Includes Three buses with drivers/guides picking up at the Doubletree Hotel in Niagara Falls, NY. Guests will be taken to the Maid of the Mist boat where they will ride the cruise and view the Falls from the Niagara Observation Tower. Guests will then visit Goat Island to view Niagara Falls from Terrapin Point and Luna Island. Group will be taken to the Hard Rock Cafe for dinner at 5:30. After dinner, guests will be taken back to the Doubletree by 9:00
